title: Fix stale DD engine race: shared engine ignores fresh edges after reparse
description:
Shared DD engine can serve stale graph data when a reparse occurs concurrently with a review.

build_findings always reads current db.import_edges(), but when a shared engine is already loaded (is_loaded() returns true), it discards the fresh edges and queries the old in-memory graph. The Arc<DdEngine> handed to an in-flight review survives the map removal done by the reparse path.

This violates the sutra/v1/24 acceptance criterion: "Review results identical to per-call creation."

Two sub-problems:
1. In-flight review holds Arc<DdEngine> that reparse can't invalidate
2. is_loaded() check skips re-ingestion even when DB edges have changed since last ingest

acceptance_criteria.text: Review with shared engine produces identical constraint/cycle findings as ephemeral engine created from current DB edges
Reparse between get_dd_engine() and build_findings() does not produce stale results
Test covers the concurrent reparse scenario

root_cause: build_findings checks engine.is_loaded() and skips ingestion if true, but has no way to know whether the DB edges match what the engine already ingested. The daemon removes the map entry on reparse, but any Arc clone already handed out survives.

edges.note: Codex review finding on shared DD engine
